entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that processes messages and their information elements.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: Network entity that processes messages and their information elements.

entities.name: Out of sequence IE
entities.description: Information element that appears out of sequence in a message.

entities.name: Comprehension required IE
entities.description: Information element encoded as comprehension required according to 3GPP TS 24.007.

entities.name: Ignore condition for out of sequence IEs
entities.description: Condition where out of sequence IEs that are not comprehension required should be ignored.

relations.description: UE behavior is governed by the condition to ignore non-comprehension-required out of sequence IEs.
The ignore condition applies to out of sequence IEs.
The ignore condition does not apply to comprehension required IEs.
Network behavior should follow the same approach as UE for ignoring out of sequence IEs.
